source: Pew Research Center, Spring 2025 Global Attitudes Survey, 'In 25-Country Survey, Americans Especially Likely To View Fellow Citizens as Morally Bad' (2026-03-05), 'Mixed views on the morality of gambling' chart: https://www.pewresearch.org/religion/2026/03/05/in-25-country-survey-americans-especially-likely-to-view-fellow-citizens-as-morally-bad/
method: Transcribed by reading the report's published chart, not computed from microdata. Share saying gambling is 'morally unacceptable' (U.S.: 'morally wrong'). Outside the U.S., 28,333 adults surveyed by phone Jan. 8-Apr. 26, 2025. Latter-day Saints are not broken out.
acceptable_note: Share saying gambling is 'morally acceptable', read from the same Pew chart. Pew labels it on the bar for most countries; for Indonesia, India and Turkey the sliver is unlabeled, so those three values are derived as (total 'not morally wrong') minus ('not a moral issue') and may be off by 1 point from rounding.
